question: How is pacifying worship classified within the threefold division of ritual worship?
premises: Worship ending with the food offering is declared pacifying.
Worship is said to be threefold.
This form constitutes one type within that classification.
inference: Pacifying worship, ending with the food offering, is one of the three kinds of worship.
plain_english: Worship ending with the food offering is declared pacifying; indeed, worship is said to be threefold.
